title: Frontend NSFW filter removed
summary:
Frontend filtering changed, text-response referral selection was adjusted, and social preview images got their missing metadata.

The frontend no longer filters content on an NSFW basis. This changes frontend behavior, not necessarily filtering elsewhere.

Referral matching now considers both input messages and generated text. Referral links have a 10% selection probability, while the Ko-fi fallback is selected 30% of the time when no relevant affiliate is found, rather than every time.

Pages now include image metadata for social previews. The change also removes duplicate social tags and updates the site's logo, icons, and banner assets.
